name: Phantom of the Blooming Rose
source:
The allegiance of the 5 big kingdoms over the past century, Ashwell Kingdom located at the center and being the biggest and most influential, Thamor Kingdom in the west who boasts of military excellence and revolutionary weapons created, Loseon Kingdom in the north known for their rich agriculture and reign over the mountainous regions, Maicheven Kingdom in the east known for increased trades and mastery in the craft of aerial weapons and transportation such as aeroplanes, and lastly the Richmond Kingdom, a seaside kingdom and the last to join the allegiance with a relatively recent lineage, has made the country of Eclaria successful in almost all aspects, outgrowing the others found within its vicinity. 

However, despite the harmonious relationships of these kingdoms, a notorious phantom thief lurks around the whole country with a hidden identity, stealing the most revered artifacts, leaving no kingdom free from his hands. Gems, chests, crowns and scepters from the past generations, he leaves none of the precious artifacts behind. No one knows particularly why the phantom thief commits such crimes, as the stolen artifacts are nowhere to be seen. Recently, the phantom thief has sent a message for Ashwell Kingdom, declaring his plans of stealing a prized possession that they treasure.

While Ashwell is governed by matriarchy, Rose D'elaphontaine Ashwell, only child of the Ashwell family and next in line to the throne, seizes the opportunity to catch the infamous phantom thief and put a stop to his crimes, therefore deeming herself worthy of serving the kingdom in the eyes of her constituents as well as the Queen herself. For the past century, the Ashwells have governed their kingdom this way, with the Queen Regent as the Head of the Kingdom and the King as her General. However, Rose is clueless as to who and what the real phantom thief is capable of, and in her case, what she doesn't know can truly harm her.

As Rose gets closer to the truth, she comes to experience baffling emotions and these foreign feelings cause a stir inside of her. She comes across two dashing men with a recognizable social status and one who has always stood by her side. Because of the phantom thief, her life takes a major 180-degree turn, changing the princess who only knew of proper courtesy, political talks and marriage solely out of convenience. When she finds out the whole truth, will she go according to plan and ascend to the throne with flying colors, or will she risk everything in the name of love?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=50256&p=487573#p487573]Lemmasoft[/url]]
translation:
过去一个世纪，五大王国维持着联盟：位于中央、规模最大且最具影响力的阿什维尔王国；以卓越军事与革命性武器闻名的西部萨莫尔王国；以丰富农业与统治山地地区闻名的北部洛森王国；以贸易繁荣、精通飞机等空中武器与交通工具制造闻名的东部梅切文王国；以及临海、血统相对年轻、最后加入联盟的里士满王国。五国联盟让埃克拉里亚几乎在所有方面都取得成功，发展速度超过周边其他国家。

然而，尽管各王国关系和谐，一名身份隐藏的著名幻影盗贼却在全国各地出没，偷走最受尊崇的文物，没有王国能逃过他的手。宝石、宝箱、王冠与权杖，无论来自哪一代，他都不放过。没人知道幻影盗贼为何犯罪，因为被盗文物从未现身。最近，幻影盗贼向阿什维尔王国发出消息，宣称要偷走他们珍视的一件宝物。

阿什维尔实行母系统治。作为阿什维尔家族独生女、王位继承人的罗斯·德拉方丹·阿什维尔抓住机会，决心逮捕臭名昭著的幻影盗贼、阻止他的罪行，并向臣民与女王证明自己有资格侍奉王国。过去一个世纪，阿什维尔家族一直如此治理国家：摄政女王是国家元首，国王则担任将军。然而，罗斯完全不了解真正的幻影盗贼是谁、拥有何种能力；对她而言，不知道真相确实可能带来伤害。

随着罗斯逐渐接近真相，她开始体验令人困惑的情感，这些陌生感受在心中掀起波澜。她遇见两名社会地位显赫、相貌英俊的男人，以及一名始终陪伴在她身边的人。因为幻影盗贼，她的人生发生180度转变：从只懂礼仪、政治谈判与为便利而结婚的公主，变成了另一个人。当她得知全部真相后，她会按计划顺利登上王位，还是会以爱情之名赌上一切？
